items.text:
अतः शुद्धिं प्रवक्ष्यामि जनने मरणे तथा ।
दिनत्रयेण शुध्यन्ति ब्राह्मणाः प्रेतसूतके ॥ ३.१ ॥
items.tr:
ataḥ śuddhiṃ pravakṣyāmi janane maraṇe tathā |
dinatrayeṇa śudhyanti brāhmaṇāḥ pretasūtake || 3.1 ||
items.en: Next I will explain purification after a birth and after a death. Brāhmaṇas become pure in three days from the impurity of a death.
items.note: sūtaka / āśauca: ritual impurity that falls on relatives after a birth or a death; during it they avoid rites and contact.

items.text:
क्षत्रियो द्वादशाहेन वैश्यः पञ्चदशाहकैः ।
शूद्रः शुध्यति मासेन पराशरवचो यथा ॥ ३.२ ॥
items.tr:
kṣatriyo dvādaśāhena vaiśyaḥ pañcadaśāhakaiḥ |
śūdraḥ śudhyati māsena parāśaravaco yathā || 3.2 ||
items.en: A kṣatriya becomes pure in twelve days, a vaiśya in fifteen days, and a śūdra in a month, as Parāśara says.

items.text:
उपासने तु विप्राणां अङ्गशुद्धिश्च जायते ।
ब्राह्मणानां प्रसूतौ तु देहस्पर्शो विधीयते ॥ ३.३ ॥
items.tr:
upāsane tu viprāṇāṃ aṅgaśuddhiśca jāyate |
brāhmaṇānāṃ prasūtau tu dehasparśo vidhīyate || 3.3 ||
items.en: For brāhmaṇas who keep the fire worship, purity of body comes (quickly). At a birth among brāhmaṇas, touching the body is allowed.

items.text:
जातौ विप्रो दशाहेन द्वादशाहेन भूमिपः ।
वैश्यः पञ्चदशाहेन शूद्रो मासेन शुध्यति ॥ ३.४ ॥
items.tr:
jātau vipro daśāhena dvādaśāhena bhūmipaḥ |
vaiśyaḥ pañcadaśāhena śūdro māsena śudhyati || 3.4 ||
items.en: After a birth, a brāhmaṇa becomes pure in ten days, a kṣatriya in twelve, a vaiśya in fifteen, and a śūdra in a month.

items.text:
एकाहाच्छुध्यते विप्रो योऽग्निवेदसमन्वितः ।
त्र्यहात्केवलवेदस्तु द्विहीनो दशभिर्दिनैः ॥ ३.५ ॥
items.tr:
ekāhācchudhyate vipro yo'gnivedasamanvitaḥ |
tryahātkevalavedastu dvihīno daśabhirdinaiḥ || 3.5 ||
items.en: A brāhmaṇa who keeps the sacred fires and knows the Veda becomes pure in one day; one who only knows the Veda, in three days; one who lacks both, in ten days.

items.text:
जन्मकर्मपरिभ्रष्टः संध्योपासनवर्जितः ।
नामधारकविप्रस्तु दशाहं सूतकी भवेत् ॥ ३.६ ॥
items.tr:
janmakarmaparibhraṣṭaḥ saṃdhyopāsanavarjitaḥ |
nāmadhārakaviprastu daśāhaṃ sūtakī bhavet || 3.6 ||
items.en: A brāhmaṇa only in name, who has fallen from the duties of his birth and does not say the saṃdhyā prayers, stays impure for ten days.

items.text:
एकपिण्डास्तु दायादाः पृथग्दारनिकेतनाः ।
जन्मन्यपि विपत्तौ च तेषां तत्सूतकं भवेत् ॥ ३.७ ॥
items.tr:
ekapiṇḍāstu dāyādāḥ pṛthagdāraniketanāḥ |
janmanyapi vipattau ca teṣāṃ tatsūtakaṃ bhavet || 3.7 ||
items.en: Heirs who share the same piṇḍa, even if they live in separate homes with their own wives, are subject to that impurity at both birth and death.
items.note: piṇḍa: rice-ball offered to ancestors; those who share it are close blood relatives.

items.text:
तावत्तत्सूतकं गोत्रे चतुर्थपुरुषेण तु ।
दायाद्विच्छेदं आप्नोति पञ्चमो वात्मवंशजः ॥ ३.८ ॥
items.tr:
tāvattatsūtakaṃ gotre caturthapuruṣeṇa tu |
dāyādvicchedaṃ āpnoti pañcamo vātmavaṃśajaḥ || 3.8 ||
items.en: That impurity applies in the gotra up to the fourth generation; the fifth descendant of one's line is no longer counted as an heir.

items.text:
चतुर्थे दशरात्रं स्यात्षण्णिशाः पुंसि पञ्चमे ।
षष्ठे चतुरहाच्छुद्धिः सप्तमे तु दिनत्रयात् ॥ ३.९ ॥
items.tr:
caturthe daśarātraṃ syātṣaṇṇiśāḥ puṃsi pañcame |
ṣaṣṭhe caturahācchuddhiḥ saptame tu dinatrayāt || 3.9 ||
items.en: For the fourth generation it is ten nights; for a man of the fifth, six nights; for the sixth, purity comes after four days; and for the seventh, after three days.

items.text:
भृग्वग्निमरणे चैव देशान्तरमृते तथा ।
बाले प्रेते च संन्यस्ते सद्यः शौचं विधीयते ॥ ३.१० ॥
items.tr:
bhṛgvagnimaraṇe caiva deśāntaramṛte tathā |
bāle prete ca saṃnyaste sadyaḥ śaucaṃ vidhīyate || 3.10 ||
items.en: When death is by a fall from a cliff or by fire, when someone dies in a foreign land, when a child dies, or when an ascetic dies, purity is immediate.

items.text:
देशान्तरमृतः कश्चित्सगोत्रः श्रूयते यदि ।
न त्रिरात्रं अहोरात्रं सद्यः स्नात्वा शुचिर्भवेत् ॥ ३.११ ॥
items.tr:
deśāntaramṛtaḥ kaścitsagotraḥ śrūyate yadi |
na trirātraṃ ahorātraṃ sadyaḥ snātvā śucirbhavet || 3.11 ||
items.en: If one hears that a man of the same gotra has died in a distant land, there is no three-night or one-day impurity; one becomes pure at once by bathing.

items.text:
देशान्तरगतो विप्रः प्रयासात्कालकारितात् ।
देहनाशं अनुप्राप्तस्तिथिर्न ज्ञायते यदि ॥ ३.१२ ॥
items.tr:
deśāntaragato vipraḥ prayāsātkālakāritāt |
dehanāśaṃ anuprāptastithirna jñāyate yadi || 3.12 ||
items.en: If a brāhmaṇa who has gone to a distant land dies from hardship or from age, and the lunar day of his death is not known,
items.note: tithi: lunar day, used to fix the date of rites for the dead.

items.text:
कृष्णाष्टमी त्वमावास्या कृष्णा चैकादशी च या ।
उदकं पिण्डदानं च तत्र श्राद्धं च कारयेत् ॥ ३.१३ ॥
items.tr:
kṛṣṇāṣṭamī tvamāvāsyā kṛṣṇā caikādaśī ca yā |
udakaṃ piṇḍadānaṃ ca tatra śrāddhaṃ ca kārayet || 3.13 ||
items.en: … then on the eighth day of the dark fortnight, the new-moon day, or the eleventh day of the dark fortnight, one should offer water and piṇḍas and perform his śrāddha.
items.note: śrāddha: the rite of offerings to dead ancestors.

items.text:
अजातदन्ता ये बाला ये च गर्भाद्विनिःसृताः ।
न तेषां अग्निसंस्कारो नाशौचं नोदकक्रिया ॥ ३.१४ ॥
items.tr:
ajātadantā ye bālā ye ca garbhādviniḥsṛtāḥ |
na teṣāṃ agnisaṃskāro nāśaucaṃ nodakakriyā || 3.14 ||
items.en: For children who die before their teeth come, and for those born dead from the womb, there is no cremation, no impurity and no water offering.

items.text:
यदि गर्भो विपद्येत स्रवते वापि योषितः ।
यावन्मासं स्थितो गर्भो दिनं तावत्तु सूतकम् ॥ ३.१५ ॥
items.tr:
yadi garbho vipadyeta sravate vāpi yoṣitaḥ |
yāvanmāsaṃ sthito garbho dinaṃ tāvattu sūtakam || 3.15 ||
items.en: If a woman loses her pregnancy or it flows away, the impurity lasts as many days as the months the foetus was in the womb.

items.text:
आ चतुर्थाद्भवेत्स्रावः पातः पञ्चमषष्ठयोः ।
अत ऊर्ध्वं प्रसूतिः स्याद्दशाहं सूतकं भवेत् ॥ ३.१६ ॥
items.tr:
ā caturthādbhavetsrāvaḥ pātaḥ pañcamaṣaṣṭhayoḥ |
ata ūrdhvaṃ prasūtiḥ syāddaśāhaṃ sūtakaṃ bhavet || 3.16 ||
items.en: Up to the fourth month it is called a flow; in the fifth and sixth months, a fall; after that it is a birth, and the impurity is ten days.

items.text:
दन्तजातेऽनुजाते च कृतचूडे च संस्थिते ।
अग्निसंस्करणे तेषां त्रिरात्रं अशुचिर्भवेत् ॥ ३.१६.१ ॥
items.tr:
dantajāte'nujāte ca kṛtacūḍe ca saṃsthite |
agnisaṃskaraṇe teṣāṃ trirātraṃ aśucirbhavet || 3.16.1 ||
items.en: When a child dies after its teeth have come, or after that, or after its tonsure, and it is cremated, (the relatives) are impure for three nights.

items.text:
आ दन्तजन्मनः सद्य आ चूडान्नैषिकी स्मृता ।
त्रिरात्रं आ व्रतादेशाद्दशरात्रं अतः परं ॥ ३.१७ ॥
items.tr:
ā dantajanmanaḥ sadya ā cūḍānnaiṣikī smṛtā |
trirātraṃ ā vratādeśāddaśarātraṃ ataḥ paraṃ || 3.17 ||
items.en: Until the teeth come, purity is immediate; until the tonsure, it is one night; until the thread initiation, three nights; after that, ten nights.

items.text:
ब्रह्मचारी गृहे येषां हूयते च हुताशनः ।
संपर्कं न च कुर्वन्ति न तेषां सूतकं भवेत् ॥ ३.१८ ॥
items.tr:
brahmacārī gṛhe yeṣāṃ hūyate ca hutāśanaḥ |
saṃparkaṃ na ca kurvanti na teṣāṃ sūtakaṃ bhavet || 3.18 ||
items.en: In a house where there is a brahmacārī and where offerings are made into the sacred fire, if they avoid contact, there is no impurity for them.

items.text:
संपर्काद्दुष्यते विप्रो जनने मरणे तथा ।
संपर्काच्च निवृत्तस्य न प्रेतं नैव सूतकं ॥ ३.१९ ॥
items.tr:
saṃparkādduṣyate vipro janane maraṇe tathā |
saṃparkācca nivṛttasya na pretaṃ naiva sūtakaṃ || 3.19 ||
items.en: A brāhmaṇa becomes impure through contact at a birth or a death. For one who keeps away from contact, there is no death impurity and no birth impurity.

items.text:
शिल्पिनः कारुका वैद्या दासीदासाश्च नापिताः ।
राजानः श्रोत्रियाश्चैव सद्यः शौचाः प्रकीर्तिताः ॥ ३.२० ॥
items.tr:
śilpinaḥ kārukā vaidyā dāsīdāsāśca nāpitāḥ |
rājānaḥ śrotriyāścaiva sadyaḥ śaucāḥ prakīrtitāḥ || 3.20 ||
items.en: Craftsmen, artisans, physicians, female and male servants, barbers, kings and learned Vedic scholars are said to become pure at once.

items.text:
सव्रतः सत्रपूतश्च आहिताग्निश्च यो द्विजः ।
राज्ञश्च सूतकं नास्ति यस्य चेच्छति पार्थिवः ॥ ३.२१ ॥
items.tr:
savrataḥ satrapūtaśca āhitāgniśca yo dvijaḥ |
rājñaśca sūtakaṃ nāsti yasya cecchati pārthivaḥ || 3.21 ||
items.en: For a twice-born man under a vow, one purified by a long sacrifice, one who keeps the sacred fires, the king, and anyone whom the king wishes, there is no impurity.

items.text:
उद्यतो निधने दाने आर्तो विप्रो निमन्त्रितः ।
तदैव ऋषिभिर्दृष्टं यथा कालेन शुध्यति ॥ ३.२२ ॥
items.tr:
udyato nidhane dāne ārto vipro nimantritaḥ |
tadaiva ṛṣibhirdṛṣṭaṃ yathā kālena śudhyati || 3.22 ||
items.en: One engaged in battle, one engaged in giving a gift, one in distress, and a brāhmaṇa who has been invited: the sages saw that these become pure at once, as others do over time.

items.text:
प्रसवे गृहमेधी तु न कुर्यात्संकरं यदि ।
दशाहाच्छुध्यते माता त्ववगाह्य पिता शुचिः ॥ ३.२३ ॥
items.tr:
prasave gṛhamedhī tu na kuryātsaṃkaraṃ yadi |
daśāhācchudhyate mātā tvavagāhya pitā śuciḥ || 3.23 ||
items.en: At a birth, if the householder avoids contact, the mother becomes pure after ten days, and the father becomes pure by bathing.

items.text:
सर्वेषां शावं आशौचं माता पित्रोस्तु सूतकम् ।
सूतकं मातुरेव स्यादुपस्पृश्य पिता शुचिः ॥ ३.२४ ॥
items.tr:
sarveṣāṃ śāvaṃ āśaucaṃ mātā pitrostu sūtakam |
sūtakaṃ mātureva syādupaspṛśya pitā śuciḥ || 3.24 ||
items.en: Death impurity applies to all (relatives); birth impurity applies to the mother and father. Birth impurity is really the mother's alone; the father becomes pure by touching water.

items.text:
यदि पत्न्यां प्रसूतायां संपर्कं कुरुते द्विजः ।
सूतकं तु भवेत्तस्य यदि विप्रः षडङ्गवित् ॥ ३.२५ ॥
items.tr:
yadi patnyāṃ prasūtāyāṃ saṃparkaṃ kurute dvijaḥ |
sūtakaṃ tu bhavettasya yadi vipraḥ ṣaḍaṅgavit || 3.25 ||
items.en: If a twice-born man has contact with his wife after she has given birth, he incurs the birth impurity, even if he is a brāhmaṇa who knows the six limbs of the Veda.

items.text:
संपर्काज्जायते दोषो नान्यो दोषोऽस्ति वै द्विजे ।
तस्मात्सर्वप्रयत्नेन संपर्कं वर्जयेद्बुधः ॥ ३.२६ ॥
items.tr:
saṃparkājjāyate doṣo nānyo doṣo'sti vai dvije |
tasmātsarvaprayatnena saṃparkaṃ varjayedbudhaḥ || 3.26 ||
items.en: The fault comes from contact; there is no other fault in a twice-born man. Therefore a wise man should avoid contact with every effort.

items.text:
विवाहोत्सवयज्ञेषु त्वन्तरा मृतसूतके ।
पूर्वसंकल्पितं द्रव्यं दीयमानं न दुष्यति ॥ ३.२७ ॥
items.tr:
vivāhotsavayajñeṣu tvantarā mṛtasūtake |
pūrvasaṃkalpitaṃ dravyaṃ dīyamānaṃ na duṣyati || 3.27 ||
items.en: If a death or birth impurity occurs in the middle of a wedding, festival or sacrifice, things already set aside and being given are not made impure.

items.text:
अन्तरा दशाहस्य पुनर्मरणजन्मनी ।
तावत्स्यादशुचिर्विप्रो यावत्तत्स्यादनिर्दशं ॥ ३.२८ ॥
items.tr:
antarā daśāhasya punarmaraṇajanmanī |
tāvatsyādaśucirvipro yāvattatsyādanirdaśaṃ || 3.28 ||
items.en: If another death or birth happens within the ten days, the brāhmaṇa stays impure only until the first ten days are over.

items.text:
ब्राह्मणार्थे विपन्नानां बन्दिगोग्रहणे तथा ।
आहवेषु विपन्नानां एकरात्रं अशौचकं ॥ ३.२९ ॥
items.tr:
brāhmaṇārthe vipannānāṃ bandigograhaṇe tathā |
āhaveṣu vipannānāṃ ekarātraṃ aśaucakaṃ || 3.29 ||
items.en: For those who die for the sake of a brāhmaṇa, while rescuing captives or cows, or in battle, the impurity is one night.

items.text:
द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ लोके सूर्यमण्डलभेदिनौ ।
परिव्राड्योगयुक्तश्च रणे चाभिमुखो हतः ॥ ३.३० ॥
items.tr:
dvāvimau puruṣau loke sūryamaṇḍalabhedinau |
parivrāḍyogayuktaśca raṇe cābhimukho hataḥ || 3.30 ||
items.en: Two kinds of men in this world pass through the sun's orb (to the highest world): the wandering ascetic devoted to yoga, and the man killed in battle facing the enemy.

items.text:
यत्र यत्र हतः शूरः शत्रुभिः परिवेष्टितः ।
अक्षयांल्लभते लोकान्यदि क्लीबं न भाषते ॥ ३.३१ ॥
items.tr:
yatra yatra hataḥ śūraḥ śatrubhiḥ pariveṣṭitaḥ |
akṣayāṃllabhate lokānyadi klībaṃ na bhāṣate || 3.31 ||
items.en: Wherever a hero is killed while surrounded by enemies, he gains undying worlds, if he does not speak like a coward.

items.text:
संन्यस्तं ब्राह्मणं दृष्ट्वा स्थानाच्चलति भास्करः ।
एष मे मण्डलं भित्त्वा परं स्थानं प्रयास्यति ॥ ३.३२ ॥
items.tr:
saṃnyastaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā sthānāccalati bhāskaraḥ |
eṣa me maṇḍalaṃ bhittvā paraṃ sthānaṃ prayāsyati || 3.32 ||
items.en: On seeing a brāhmaṇa who has renounced the world, the sun moves from its place, thinking: 'This one will pass through my orb and go to the highest place.'

items.text:
यस्तु भग्नेषु सैन्येषु विद्रवत्सु समन्ततः ।
परित्राता यदा गच्छेत्स च क्रतुफलं लभेत् ॥ ३.३३ ॥
items.tr:
yastu bhagneṣu sainyeṣu vidravatsu samantataḥ |
paritrātā yadā gacchetsa ca kratuphalaṃ labhet || 3.33 ||
items.en: When the armies are broken and fleeing on all sides, one who goes forward to protect them gains the fruit of a Vedic sacrifice.

items.text:
यस्य च्छेदक्षतं गात्रं शरमुद्गरयष्टिभिः ।
देवकन्यास्तु तं वीरं हरन्ति रमयन्ति च ॥ ३.३४ ॥
items.tr:
yasya cchedakṣataṃ gātraṃ śaramudgarayaṣṭibhiḥ |
devakanyāstu taṃ vīraṃ haranti ramayanti ca || 3.34 ||
items.en: When a hero's body is cut and wounded by arrows, clubs and staffs, divine maidens carry him away and give him delight.

items.text:
देवाङ्गनासहस्राणि शूरं आयोधने हतम् ।
त्वरमाणाः प्रधावन्ति मम भर्ता ममेति च ॥ ३.३५ ॥
items.tr:
devāṅganāsahasrāṇi śūraṃ āyodhane hatam |
tvaramāṇāḥ pradhāvanti mama bhartā mameti ca || 3.35 ||
items.en: Thousands of divine women run quickly to a hero killed in battle, crying, 'He is my husband! He is mine!'

items.text:
यं यज्ञसंघैस्तपसा च विप्राः स्वर्गैषिणो वात्र यथा यान्ति ।
क्षणेन यान्त्येव हि तत्र वीराः प्राणान्सुयुद्धेन परित्यजन्तः ॥ ३.३६ ॥
items.tr:
yaṃ yajñasaṃghaistapasā ca viprāḥ svargaiṣiṇo vātra yathā yānti |
kṣaṇena yāntyeva hi tatra vīrāḥ prāṇānsuyuddhena parityajantaḥ || 3.36 ||
items.en: The place that brāhmaṇas seeking heaven reach through many sacrifices and austerities, heroes reach in a moment by giving up their lives in a fair fight.

items.text:
जितेन लभ्यते लक्ष्मीर्मृतेनापि सुराङ्गनाः ।
क्षणध्वंसिनि कायेऽस्मिन्का चिन्ता मरणे रणे ॥ ३.३७ ॥
items.tr:
jitena labhyate lakṣmīrmṛtenāpi surāṅganāḥ |
kṣaṇadhvaṃsini kāye'sminkā cintā maraṇe raṇe || 3.37 ||
items.en: If he wins, he gains wealth; if he dies, he gains divine women. This body is destroyed in a moment, so why worry about dying in battle?

items.text:
ललाटदेशे रुधिरं स्रवच्च यस्याहवे तु प्रविशेच्च वक्त्रम् ।
तत्सोमपानेन किलास्य तुल्यं संग्रामयज्ञे विधिवच्च दृष्टम् ॥ ३.३८ ॥
items.tr:
lalāṭadeśe rudhiraṃ sravacca yasyāhave tu praviśecca vaktram |
tatsomapānena kilāsya tulyaṃ saṃgrāmayajñe vidhivacca dṛṣṭam || 3.38 ||
items.en: When blood flowing from a warrior's forehead in battle enters his mouth, that is said to equal drinking Soma, as rightly laid down for the sacrifice of battle.
items.note: Soma: the sacred drink offered and drunk in Vedic sacrifices.

items.text:
अनाथं ब्राह्मणं प्रेतं ये वहन्ति द्विजातयः ।
पदे पदे यज्ञफलं आनुपूर्व्यांल्लभन्ति ते ॥ ३.३९ ॥
items.tr:
anāthaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ pretaṃ ye vahanti dvijātayaḥ |
pade pade yajñaphalaṃ ānupūrvyāṃllabhanti te || 3.39 ||
items.en: Twice-born men who carry the dead body of a brāhmaṇa who has no one gain, step by step, the fruit of a sacrifice.

items.text:
न तेषां अशुभं किंचित्पापं वा शुभकर्मणाम् ।
जलावगाहनात्तेषां सद्यःशौचं विधीयते ॥ ३.४० ॥
items.tr:
na teṣāṃ aśubhaṃ kiṃcitpāpaṃ vā śubhakarmaṇām |
jalāvagāhanātteṣāṃ sadyaḥśaucaṃ vidhīyate || 3.40 ||
items.en: No harm or sin comes to those who do such good deeds; for them, purity is immediate on bathing in water.

items.text:
असगोत्रं अबन्धुं च प्रेतीभूतं द्विजोत्तमम् ।
वहित्वा च दहित्वा च प्राणायामेन शुध्यति ॥ ३.४१ ॥
items.tr:
asagotraṃ abandhuṃ ca pretībhūtaṃ dvijottamam |
vahitvā ca dahitvā ca prāṇāyāmena śudhyati || 3.41 ||
items.en: One who carries and cremates the body of a good brāhmaṇa who is not of his gotra and not his relative becomes pure by prāṇāyāma.
items.note: prāṇāyāma: controlled breathing, used as a minor purification.

items.text:
अनुगम्येच्छया प्रेतं ज्ञातिं अज्ञातिं एव वा ।
स्नात्वा सचैलं स्पृष्ट्वाग्निं घृतं प्राश्य विशुध्यति ॥ ३.४२ ॥
items.tr:
anugamyecchayā pretaṃ jñātiṃ ajñātiṃ eva vā |
snātvā sacailaṃ spṛṣṭvāgniṃ ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśudhyati || 3.42 ||
items.en: One who, of his own wish, follows a funeral procession, of a relative or not, becomes pure by bathing with his clothes on, touching fire and eating ghee.

items.text:
क्षत्रियं मृतं अज्ञानाद्ब्राह्मणो योऽनुगच्छति ।
एकाहं अशुचिर्भूत्वा पञ्चगव्येन शुध्यति ॥ ३.४३ ॥
items.tr:
kṣatriyaṃ mṛtaṃ ajñānādbrāhmaṇo yo'nugacchati |
ekāhaṃ aśucirbhūtvā pañcagavyena śudhyati || 3.43 ||
items.en: A brāhmaṇa who unknowingly follows (the body of) a dead kṣatriya is impure for one day and becomes pure with pañcagavya.
items.note: pañcagavya: a purifying mixture of five cow products: milk, curd, ghee, urine and dung.

items.text:
शवं च वैश्यं अज्ञानाद्ब्राह्मणो योऽनुगच्छति ।
कृत्वाशौचं द्विरात्रं च प्राणायामान्षडाचरेत् ॥ ३.४४ ॥
items.tr:
śavaṃ ca vaiśyaṃ ajñānādbrāhmaṇo yo'nugacchati |
kṛtvāśaucaṃ dvirātraṃ ca prāṇāyāmānṣaḍācaret || 3.44 ||
items.en: A brāhmaṇa who unknowingly follows the body of a vaiśya should keep impurity for two nights and do six prāṇāyāmas.

items.text:
प्रेतीभूतं तु यः शूद्रं ब्राह्मणो ज्ञानदुर्बलः ।
अनुगच्छेन्नीयमानं त्रिरात्रं अशुचिर्भवेत् ॥ ३.४५ ॥
items.tr:
pretībhūtaṃ tu yaḥ śūdraṃ brāhmaṇo jñānadurbalaḥ |
anugacchennīyamānaṃ trirātraṃ aśucirbhavet || 3.45 ||
items.en: A brāhmaṇa weak in understanding who follows the body of a dead śūdra as it is carried away is impure for three nights.

items.text:
त्रिरात्रे तु ततः पूर्णे नदीं गत्वा समुद्रगाम् ।
प्राणायामशतं कृत्वा घृतं प्राश्य विशुध्यति ॥ ३.४६ ॥
items.tr:
trirātre tu tataḥ pūrṇe nadīṃ gatvā samudragām |
prāṇāyāmaśataṃ kṛtvā ghṛtaṃ prāśya viśudhyati || 3.46 ||
items.en: When the three nights are over, he should go to a river that flows to the sea, do a hundred prāṇāyāmas and eat ghee; then he is pure.

items.text:
विनिर्वर्त्य यदा शूद्रा उदकान्तं उपस्थिताः ।
द्विजैस्तदानुगन्तव्या एष धर्मः सनातनः ॥ ३.४७ ॥
items.tr:
vinirvartya yadā śūdrā udakāntaṃ upasthitāḥ |
dvijaistadānugantavyā eṣa dharmaḥ sanātanaḥ || 3.47 ||
items.en: When the śūdras have finished (the rites) and come to the water's edge, the twice-born should follow them then. This is the eternal dharma.
items.note: Unclear verse; who follows whom and why is uncertain. Best reading given.
